fix(skills): restrict recall filters to valid source/signal pairs (#503)

* fix(skills): restrict recall filters to valid source/signal pairs

Previously, `source` and `signal` were exposed as independent enums,
allowing agents to generate invalid combinations.

Replace them with a centralized list of the 9 valid `(source, signal)`
pairs and document that any other combination must not be sent to
`memori_recall`.

* Bump package version for OC npm

* Validate source/signal pairs in memori_recall

Enforce and validate (source, signal) pairs for the memori_recall tool. Updated parameter descriptions to require source and signal to be set together and added a VALID_PAIRS mapping that checks allowed pairs. If only one is provided or the pair is invalid, the tool now returns a structured error, logs a warning, and skips the recall. Adjusted existing tests to use the correct (fact, verification) example and added a new test suite covering missing, invalid, omitted, and all valid (source, signal) pairs.

* Fixed linting and format errors

* Refine documentation for memori_recall to clarify source/signal pair requirements.
